raw_response:
I am 78 years old now, and this small plot of mine is for cassava and some local beans that I intercrop to feed my family. I do not have money to buy chemical fertilizer or those expensive seeds from the shop, and at my age I have learned that these crops grow well enough with the rains God sends us here in Mtwara. My children and grandchildren help me when they can, so I will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting with family hands, but I will not pay for outside workers on this little piece.
